title: Successful refreshes emitted failure-level source annotations
detail: Two successful workflow runs included failure-level Hotspawn annotations even though their complete jobs and verify_live steps passed. Branch validation run 39602172050 reported HTTP 403 and lobby/API disagreement annotations. The later production Pages run 39618159014 also reported HTTP 403 and lobby/API disagreement annotations, while its inventory annotation reported a complete lobby/CS2 cross-check and its site deployment succeeded. At 2026-10-21T15:01:17Z the production snapshot reported 73 total records (9 upcoming, 64 archived), complete coverage, 9 active complete-pick rows, 9 with picks/probabilities, and 0 unresolved in that ladder; the separate featured stage reported 6 picks and 3 unresolved. Because individual annotation context and the Pages artifact are not readable in this workspace, this flag does not interpret the source errors as a failed collection or dismiss them as harmless. Check the linked run annotations and the live row evidence. No value is inferred.
